column3: “It was given” renders “was given to it”; BSB keeps “star” as subject.
“The star” is added as subject.
“Descended” renders ἐξῆλθον (“came forth”).
“Any plant” renders χλωρὸν (“any green thing”); BSB leaves out “men” (ἀνθρώπους).
“The locusts” and “only” are added; “the stinging of a scorpion” recasts “the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man.”
“Will escape them” renders the present φεύγει (“flees from them”).
“Looked like” renders “the appearance … [was] like”; “crowns of gold” renders “crowns like gold.”
Close to the Greek.
“Thoraxes” is added; “many horses and chariots” recasts “chariots of many horses.”
BSB follows the critical text, with the power “in their tails,” but recasts it with “which had the power.”
“They were ruled by a king” renders “they have over them a king.”
“Are still to follow” renders “are coming still … after these things.”
Close to the Greek.
Close to the Greek.
“This” before “hour” is added.
“Two hundred million” renders “twice ten thousand ten thousands”; “mounted troops” renders “armies of the cavalry.”
“Looked like this” renders “thus I saw”; “sapphire” renders ὑακινθίνους (“hyacinth-colored”). “The riders” is added.
“Of fire, smoke, and sulfur” joins the plagues to their list.
“Indeed” is added; “with which to inflict harm” renders “and with them they injure.”
“They did not stop worshiping” recasts “so that they will not worship.”
Close to the Greek.
